structural_change: Q-KVFIX 0130 (successor of FLOW-HOLD bh1 qkd_embgw-bh1-9c5e10555 NEEDS_RTL TT -45.87 / FF -4.12, 511 reg->reg D pins; textbook: u_gw.rr[1] -> u_gw.w[6] ~688 ps, 18 levels): the gateway request FIFO head is a register (ot_qfd_emb_gw HEADQ=1, show-ahead head loaded from 2 precomputed candidates rq'[rr] / rq'[rr+1] by a 2:1 mux on the pop decision), so the 32:1 x 25-b read mux leaves the serve decision -> eq_d / sv / rr / w path; the four slot checks run in parallel and select 1 b by lk; the 512-b answer register eq_d loads every cycle from the selected slot (no decision-driven load enable on 512 D pins; t_eq data is eq_v-qualified, valid words bit-identical, same cycle). First gate (head only) still showed w -> rh_q ~638 ps est, hence the enable/parallel-check change. Cycle-identical (0 added cycles: same answers, same fetch cycles); kit = bh1 (recipe 4 hold_budget die, flop-first pins).

reroute_reason.why: RTL changed (HEADQ registered request head, setup fix for bh1 -45.87 ps); also carries the FLOW-HOLD bh1 native fix (sl2 native FAIL launch 312.0 > 220 on 1,072 outputs, results/arch/boundary_hold_budget_1016/impact.json)
